name: Shushtar Historical Hydraulic System
description: In Iran's Khuzestan province, the island city of Shushtar sits inside an ancient water-engineering project that may go back to Darius the Great. Canals cut from the Karun River still feed tunnels and watermills, then drop over a cliff in a rushing cascade. Beyond the city, the diverted water irrigates the green orchards and farmland of Mianab, "Paradise.
